test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the amount Ravi needs to return to Monu, if he had borrowed Rs. 3,000 from Monu at 4% p.a. compound interest, compounded annually, 2 years ago.
solution:
**Formula Used:**

Amount, A = P(1 + r/n)ⁿt

where,

 
• P = Principal amount (Rs. 3,000)
 
• r = Annual interest rate (4% or 0.04)
 
• n = Number of times interest is compounded per year (1)
 
• t = Time the money is invested for (2 years)

 

**Calculation:**

We have,

P = 3,000, r = 0.04, n = 1, t = 2

⇒ A = 3,000(1 + 0.04/1)¹×²

⇒ A = 3,000(1 + 0.04)²

⇒ A = 3,000(1.04)²

⇒ A = 3,000 × 1.0816

⇒ A = 3,244.80

**Hence, Ravi needs to return Rs. 3,244.80 to Monu.**
